blocks.text: MINNEAPOLIS— Jaden McDaniels scored a career-best 34 points and the Minnesota Timberwolves routed the Brooklyn Nets 142-116 in the NBA on Monday night. Ayo Dosunmu added 23 as six Timberwolves players reached double figures. Terrence Shannon Jr. had 17 points and five assists off the bench, and Jonathan Kuminga scored 15.
